title: concurrent_cache_rwlock
summary: A small in-memory cache guarded by an RwLock with one writer thread recording and clearing updates and one reader thread inspecting cached data concurrently.

domain_types.name: CacheEntry
domain_types.description: In-memory cache entry struct holding cached payload data and pure accessor/update methods

clauses.text: The writer thread acquires the write lock to record an update.
The writer thread later acquires the write lock to clear pending updates.
The reader thread acquires the read lock to inspect cached data concurrently with other readers.
CacheEntry stores cached payload data and provides pure accessor/update methods in memory.
Both the writer and reader threads must eventually complete.

requirements.text: The writer thread acquires the write lock to record an update.
The writer thread later acquires the write lock to clear pending updates.
The reader thread acquires the read lock to inspect cached data concurrently with other readers.
CacheEntry stores cached payload data and provides pure accessor/update methods in memory.
Both the writer and reader threads must eventually complete.

source_nl: Build a small concurrent cache guarded by a read-write lock (`RwLock`) storing an in-memory cache entry struct. One writer thread acquires a write lock to record an update and later clear pending updates, while a reader thread acquires a read lock to inspect the cached data concurrently. Make sure the program never deadlocks and both threads complete.
